purpose: Teach: 西川/横山/藤本/新田/飯田/西尾/木下/秋山

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、お友達の西川社長と共同事業をされた
lines.en: Dad, when you were young, you started a joint venture with your friend President Nishikawa, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective inquiry. Opens with quiet curiosity. Patient pacing — leaving space for memory to settle. A son prompting his father to remember something cherished, without urgency.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは横山先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. Father received mentorship from my senior, Yokoyama.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Clear and direct, with a subtle weight of gratitude in the name Yokoyama. Not hurried — taking time to honor the memory. Steady gaze inward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、藤本氏と新規事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Dad, when you were young, you launched a new venture with Fujimoto, didn't you?
lines.style: Softer follow-up, inviting another memory. Warmth underneath the question. A slight lean forward in the voice — gentle persistence, the tone of someone drawing out beloved stories.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新田氏を社員一人目として採用された
lines.en: Yes. Father hired Nitta as his first employee.
lines.style: Quiet pride beneath the surface. The words land with understated significance — the weight of a first hire, a first risk. Speaking from somewhere deep, not performing the emotion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、飯田氏と先輩後輩の関係だった
lines.en: Dad, when you were young, you had a senior-junior relationship with Iida, didn't you?
lines.style: Another gentle prompt, same cadence as before. Nostalgic but not sad — the tone of tracing the shape of a life well-lived. Unhurried, inviting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは西尾広報の初代担当をされた
lines.en: Yes. Father was the first public relations officer at Nishio.
lines.style: Same steady composure. A moment of quiet recognition — the first of something always carries weight. Spoken plainly, but the plainness itself is reverent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、木下氏との出会いに感謝された
lines.en: Dad, when you were young, you were grateful for meeting Kinoshita, weren't you?
lines.style: Softest of the prompts. Almost a whisper in tone — less a question, more an invitation to share something precious. Held with tenderness, no expectation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは秋山氏に技術部を任された
lines.en: Yes. Father entrusted Akiyama with the technical division.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment — a gentle closing. Speaks the name Akiyama with particular care. Slow, present, the tone of a son recognizing his father's legacy and his own place within it. A benediction.
